title: Law to drop 2026 deadline for see-through security grilles
summary: This bill would repeal the requirement that all existing security grilles on business storefronts have at least 70 percent visibility by July 1, 2026, ending the fines tied to that deadline. Grilles would still need to meet the 70 percent visibility rule when replaced going forward. It would also require the Department of Buildings to conduct outreach to businesses on grille rules between June and December 2026 and report to the Council by February 1, 2027.
